applicability.predicate: LRFD structural design includes roof rain load R

design_actions: evaluate every printed LRFD base combination using signed, dimensionally compatible load effects; derive the clause 6-2-3-2(a) L factor as 0.5 only when L0 is below 5 kPa, occupancy is neither parking nor public assembly, and no section 6-5-5 live-load reduction was already applied; otherwise retain factor 1.0; expand each Lr/S/R alternative and both signs of W/E; keep wind and seismic alternatives separate rather than combining them; identify the governing absolute effect only for a declared symmetric capacity envelope

design_actions: select lu from actual geometry; independently compute relation 6-7-5 as drift width w=hd^2/hc; preserve the printed clause anomaly that describes 0.75 of that width relation as a maximum height and require an explicit structural interpretation instead of silently treating width as height

design_actions: derive R1 from member tributary area; derive S as slope percent for pitched roofs or 267 times rise/span for curved and domed roofs, never from degree angle; compute R2 and Lr=L0*R1*R2 only for ordinary roofs/canopies and enforce the printed limits

applicability.predicate: rainwater design/specification/construction is in an applicable project stage

design_actions: at design, produce plans, sections, details, calculations, material specifications and protection methods; require authority approval only for an actual post-permit change or innovative product; require physical storage, utility-access and landscape-protection inspection records only at construction/final inspection

rules.title_fa: بار انبارش موقت لوله و اتصالات بهداشتی

sources.clause: جدول پ 6-3، ردیف لوله و اتصالات بهداشتی

applicability.predicate: a construction-stage pipe/fitting storage zone is planned on a structural floor

exceptions.predicate: verified construction plan has no applicable pipe storage zone

design_actions: compute footprint area; use the printed 9 kN/m3 table method only within its 1.80 m stack-height applicability; above or outside that basis require a valid alternative load calculation rather than impose a storage prohibition; prohibit double counting and transmit the calculated total to the same-model structural response

rules.title_fa: افزایش جرم چوب در معرض باران و رطوبت

applicability.predicate: a wood rainwater support/roof component is exposed to rain, saturation or fresh-cut moisture state

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no applicable wood rain-exposed component

design_actions: derive design density from dry density plus 80 kg/m3 for rain-unprotected wood, plus 120 kg/m3 for saturated wood, or the printed 1.8 fresh-cut factor; compute mass and kN load and transmit that exact load to the same-model structural response

rules.title_fa: بار مرده حجمی مصالح بام و اجزای آب باران

sources.clause: جدول پ 6-2-1، ردیف فلزات؛ جدول پ 6-2-2، ردیف‌های 3، 4 و 7

applicability.predicate: a listed concrete, aggregate, fill, membrane or miscellaneous material is actually selected in the roof/rainwater assembly

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no applicable listed volumetric material

design_actions: use the printed density only for an actually selected material; compute mass from actual volume and gravity load in kN; reject duplicate component identities or loads already included elsewhere; transmit the exact calculated load to the same-model structural response

rules.title_fa: بار مرده سطحی پوشش بام با رفع رسمی ابهام واحد چاپی

applicability.predicate: a listed clay-tile or bitumen-felt roof covering is actually selected

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no applicable listed roof covering

design_actions: do not silently reinterpret the printed volumetric column heading; require a provenance-valid official/engineer unit interpretation, then compute mass from actual covering area, reject duplicate/double-counted components and transmit the exact kN load to the same structural model

rules.title_fa: سازگاری لوله قائم آب باران با تغییرمکان نسبی طبقه

applicability.predicate: a vertical rainwater route, support or penetration crosses storeys subject to lateral drift

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no applicable multi-storey vertical rainwater interface

design_actions: consume the structural owner's ten-year-service-wind relative displacement for the same model; compare it with 0.0025 storey height or a smaller component damage limit; select joint allowance at least equal to calculated displacement or block the coordinated route

rules.title_fa: بار باد لوله خارجی بلند آب باران

sources.clause: شکل پ 6-4-8 فشار روی لوله‌ها و کابل‌ها

applicability.predicate: an exterior rainwater pipe has exposed length/diameter greater than 100 and falls within the printed smooth or medium-rough pipe cases

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no applicable exposed slender rainwater pipe

design_actions: derive projected area d*l and printed Cf from surface roughness and d*sqrt(q*Ce); compute F=Cf*q*Cg*Ce*A*Iw; transmit exact force to the same-model support response and do not apply the figure outside length/diameter greater than 100

rules.title_fa: استقرار و اتصال ایمن تجهیزات آب باران در فضای باز ساختمان

applicability.predicate: rainwater storage, pumping or treatment equipment is installed on a roof, terrace, balcony or semi-open building space

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no outdoor rainwater equipment

design_actions: place the actual equipment footprint inside the declared open-space polygon; keep every selected attachment point on that footprint; consume same-model architecture and structural anchorage responses bound to the equipment identity; reposition or block the coordinated output when the facade/volume or anchorage review fails

rules.title_fa: مسیر عملی خروج و تعویض تجهیزات سنگین آب باران

applicability.predicate: a machine room contains heavy rainwater storage, pumping or treatment equipment that must be removable or replaceable

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no applicable heavy rainwater equipment

design_actions: select an actual continuous removal path from the equipment footprint to the declared exit; keep the full width-based swept envelope, including corners and doors, inside a verified clearance corridor and outside the complete obstruction inventory; cover the entire path length with continuous width/height clearance segments at least equal to the equipment transport envelope; reroute, enlarge the opening or block conforming output when any condition fails
output_evidence: selected path, swept envelope, corridor and exit polygon

rules.title_fa: بار یخ جوی روی لوله و نگهدارنده نمایان آب باران

applicability.predicate: an exposed rainwater pipe or support is sensitive to atmospheric ice

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no exposed ice-sensitive rainwater component

design_actions: derive Fz=min((Z/10)^0.1,1.4), td=2*t*Ii*Fz, encasing ice area Ai=pi*td*(Dc+td), volume and 0.9-water-density ice weight; pass both weight and ice-increased diameter to the same-model structural/wind response; require an official local fifty-year thickness in applicable severe mountain conditions and a specialist dynamic study where flexible-component dynamics matter

rules.title_fa: نوارهای کناری و حالت‌های فشار و مکش پوشش بام

applicability.predicate: roof cladding or a rainwater component attachment depends on roof wind zones

exceptions.predicate: verified rainwater design has no roof cladding/attachment wind-zone interface

design_actions: select the printed roof figure from actual form and degree slope; compute edge width as max(min(10% of smallest plan dimension,40% eave height),4% of smallest plan dimension,1 m); apply pressure and suction; apply the edge strip at ridges/hips and the low-slope corner parapet coefficient only under its stated geometry

rules.title_fa: فشار خارجی، داخلی و بار خالص باد اتصال آب باران

applicability.predicate: an actual rainwater attachment uses detailed external/internal pressure or the supported C*p corner method

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no applicable rainwater attachment wind interface

design_actions: compute external pressure P=Iw*q*Ce*Ct*Cg*Cp*Cd, add the applicable signed internal pressure algebraically, multiply the net pressure by direction-specific effective projected area and transmit the resulting force to the same-model support response; never interchange C*p with CgCp

rules.title_fa: بار و فشار باد مخزن کروی یا استوانه‌ای آب باران

applicability.predicate: an actual exterior spherical or cylindrical rainwater storage tank is exposed to wind

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no exterior wind-exposed rainwater storage tank

design_actions: for a spherical tank compute A=pi*d^2/4 and use Cf=0.2 only for the printed low-roughness and d*sqrt(q*Ce)>0.8 scope; for a cylindrical tank compute A=d*h and require Cf/Cp/Cpi from the verified figure; compute F=Iw*Cf*q*Cg*Ce*A, Pe=Cp*q*Cg*Ce, Pi=Cpi*q*Cg*Ce and net pressure Pi-Pe, then transmit force and net pressure to the same-model structural response

rules.title_fa: نیروی باد عمود و مماس نگهدارنده منفرد یا ترکیبی آب باران

applicability.predicate: an actual exposed single or combined rainwater support member uses figure A6-4-9

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no applicable exposed support member

design_actions: compute A=h*l and Fn=K*Cn_inf*q*Cg*Ce*A*Iw plus Ft=K*Ct_inf*q*Cg*Ce*A*Iw; use the printed finite-length K table or a figure-qualified coefficient for the actual l/h and transmit both forces to the same-model structural response

rules.title_fa: قرارداد سازه‌ای تجهیز آب باران واقع در پهنه واقعی سیلاب

applicability.predicate: an actual exterior rainwater asset footprint intersects a verified breakaway-wall or debris/mud-flood hazard polygon

exceptions.predicate: verified geometry has no positive-area site-flood/rainwater-asset intersection

design_actions: compute actual footprint/hazard intersection; only for positive-area overlap consume a same-model structural/flood response scoped to the exact asset and hazard type; relocate/protect the asset or block coordinated output when the response fails

rules.title_fa: بار باد سایبان یک یا دوشیبه جمع‌آوری باران

applicability.predicate: an actual mono- or dual-slope canopy collects rainwater and uses the printed canopy wind method

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no applicable rainwater-collecting canopy

design_actions: use actual canopy area and blockage phi; obtain Cf/Cpnet from the matching printed shape/geometry; compute force and pressure; evaluate I/II for monoslope and both-wings/one-wing I/II for dual slope; transmit all cases to the same-model structural response

rules.title_fa: جداسازی ارتعاش تجهیزات مکانیکی آب باران

applicability.predicate: actual rainwater pumping or treatment equipment can create undesirable building vibration

exceptions.predicate: verified manufacturer evidence shows the actual equipment cannot create undesirable vibration

design_actions: derive support points from the actual equipment footprint; consume a same-model specialist response for the actual equipment; select the required isolator type and materialize its product and analysis identities without inventing an unsourced numeric vibration threshold

rules.title_fa: بار خاک، آب زیرزمینی و پایداری جزء مدفون آب باران

applicability.predicate: an actual rainwater tank, pit or related component is buried or retains soil/groundwater and the site-specific geotechnical response approves the equivalent-fluid method

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no buried rainwater asset

design_actions: derive retained height and groundwater head from actual elevations and pressure direction; only when the site investigation approves the equivalent-fluid method compute minimum soil, adjacent surcharge, groundwater lateral pressure and floor uplift; otherwise require the owner method; consume same-model treatment of expansive soil, seismic earth pressure, integral structural action and stability
output_evidence: buried asset footprint and actual elevations

rules.title_fa: بار موقت نصب و انبارش اجزای آب باران در حین ساخت

applicability.predicate: an actual construction or installation stage temporarily stores or installs rainwater materials/equipment on a structural surface

exceptions.predicate: verified construction plan has no applicable temporary rainwater load case

design_actions: sum actual item quantity times unit mass, divide gravity load by actual loaded footprint and transmit the exact temporary load case to the same-model structural response; do not classify permanent equipment or stored water as reducible roof live load

rules.title_fa: ضریب ضربه ماشین‌آلات سامانه آب باران

applicability.predicate: actual rainwater pump or machinery has rotating or reciprocating motion and no specialist dynamic analysis replaces the printed impact method

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no applicable rainwater machinery

design_actions: multiply actual operating gravity load by at least 1.2 for rotating or 1.5 for reciprocating machinery, using any larger manufacturer factor, and transmit the resulting load to the same-model support response

rules.title_fa: سازگاری مسیر یا مخزن آب باران با جابه‌جایی بهره‌برداری و خودکرنشی

applicability.predicate: an actual rainwater route, support, joint or tank interface crosses a coordinated building movement joint or is affected by differential settlement or temperature/moisture/shrinkage/creep movement

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no applicable rainwater movement interface

design_actions: consume applicable service/self-straining cases including coordinated building-joint movement, differential settlement and restrained dimensional change; recompute the signed relative endpoint vector in declared local axes; preserve the governing case and unit; compare each vector component with the matching X/Y/Z joint capacity, using vector norm for reporting only
output_evidence: actual route/interface geometry and local axes
signed governing endpoint vector and norm
same-model analysis and reopened DXF schedule

rules.title_fa: ترکیب‌های تکمیلی سیل و یخ برای رابط واقعی سامانه آب باران

applicability.predicate: an actual rainwater asset requires flood load Fa or an actual exposed component requires atmospheric ice Di and wind-on-ice Wi

exceptions.predicate: verified design has neither an applicable site-flood rainwater asset nor an atmospheric-ice-sensitive rainwater component

design_actions: for actual flood applicability add the printed LRFD W/Fa substitutions and ASD Fa extensions; for actual ice applicability apply the printed Di/Wi LRFD and ASD substitutions; evaluate signed directions, governing case and capacity in one compatible effect unit and bind exact interface/component identities
output_evidence: flood asset and ice component identities

rules.title_fa: ارتفاع آزاد زیر پیش‌آمدگی موضعی مسیر آب باران در فضای اقامت یا اشتغال

applicability.predicate: the pipe/insulation/support bottom envelope is a local overhead projection crossing a typed habitable or occupancy space; this rule does not establish the general room clear-height requirement

exceptions.predicate: verified geometry has no applicable local overhead projection crossing

design_actions: verify the source-scope predicate for a local overhead projection, intersect the actual route bottom envelope with the typed occupied-space polygon, include pipe/insulation/support, and maintain at least 2.05 m locally above finished floor; retain general room clear height as a separate architecture-owned requirement
output_evidence: typed occupied-space polygon and local-projection classification

rules.title_fa: عدم کاهش عرض آزاد مسیر خروج توسط اجزای سامانه آب باران

applicability.predicate: an actual rainwater component footprint lies within a typed egress path whose architecture-owned required clear width is provided and whose geometry is represented by the supported straight-axis prismatic-section model

exceptions.predicate: verified complete inventory contains no rainwater component in an egress path

design_actions: for the supported straight-axis prismatic-section model, derive all critical stations and open-interval midpoints from actual egress/obstruction vertices; subtract the unioned complete rainwater footprint inventory and use maximum contiguous clear width; curved, branching or other unsupported path geometry remains INPUT_REQUIRED and cannot claim continuous proof; declared sample sections are supplemental only
output_evidence: typed egress polygon, supported model and longitudinal axis
geometry-derived critical and interval transverse-section widths

rules.title_fa: ضرایب جهت‌دار H برای جزء مدفون واقعی سامانه آب باران

applicability.predicate: an actual buried rainwater asset has lateral soil, groundwater or stored-material effect H in the matching structural model

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no buried H interface

design_actions: for additive H use 1.6 in LRFD and 1.0 in ASD; for relieving H use 0.9 LRFD and 0.6 ASD only when H is permanent, otherwise omit the relieving H effect; recompute signed cases, governing effect and capacity and bind them to the actual buried asset and same analysis/model

rules.title_fa: هماهنگی اجزای نمایان آب باران با نما و سیمای شهری

applicability.predicate: a downpipe, scupper, gutter or other rainwater component is visible on a building facade

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no visible facade rainwater component

design_actions: bind the actual visible component elevation geometry and facade identity to a provenance-valid architecture-owner response on the same model; consume that response without claiming the rainwater module performs urban-design or aesthetic review
output_evidence: reopened DXF facade coordination geometry and schedule

rules.title_fa: تراز کف ورودی اصلی در رابط واقعی رواناب معبر

applicability.predicate: the main entrance participates in an actual exterior rainwater runoff/entry-protection interface

exceptions.predicate: verified entrance has no rainwater runoff interface
special site condition has an approved local-authority adjustment with an explicit replacement limit

design_actions: compute main entrance floor elevation minus average adjacent-way elevation; for standard conditions enforce a maximum positive difference of 1200 mm; for a special local condition consume only a provenance-valid approved replacement limit; a lower entrance elevation is not converted into a fabricated violation by this maximum-above-way clause
output_evidence: calculated signed difference and governing limit

rules.title_fa: شیب، پاگرد و پوشش غیرلغزنده شیبراه پیاده در رابط رواناب

applicability.predicate: an actual pedestrian ramp/landing participates in an exterior rainwater runoff or wet-surface drainage interface; parking/vehicle-ramp limits are outside this rule

exceptions.predicate: verified design has no pedestrian ramp runoff interface

design_actions: derive every ramp slope from station/elevation geometry; limit main access/egress or accessible runs to 8 percent and other non-accessible runs to 12.5 percent; require top/bottom/turn/door and maximum-9m landings, landing slope below 2 percent in each direction and 0.90m minimum dimension where the source supplies it; for accessible routes consume a same-model owner review; bind the actual wet ramp to a hard fixed product with verified wet-pedestrian non-slip approval; require an installed wet-condition test only as stage-conditional system QA evidence, not as statutory wording; preserve the connected drainage route and no-ponding result

rules.title_fa: جلوگیری از آلودگی در رابط واقعی آب باران با ضایعات یا فاضلاب

applicability.predicate: an actual rainwater route, storage or discharge interface is near a typed waste or sewage source

exceptions.predicate: a verified complete inventory has no waste/sewage interface

design_actions: compute the minimum distance from the actual rainwater route to every typed waste/sewage source polygon and satisfy the same-model environmental-health owner requirement; reroute when the computed separation is insufficient; do not reinterpret this general hygiene clause as a rainwater-quality or reuse criterion

rules.title_fa: هندسه پیش‌آمدگی باران‌گیر یا جزء آب باران نسبت به معبر، ملک، پاسیو و حریم برق

applicability.predicate: an actual rain canopy, roof canopy or rainwater component projects beyond the building limit toward a public way or adjacent property

exceptions.predicate: verified geometry has no applicable rainwater site projection
a provenance-valid approved urban rule expressly replaces the under-12m/highway prohibition while all other duties remain satisfied

design_actions: derive projection depth from building-limit and outer-edge geometry; enforce the applicable 0.80m depth, 3.50m public-way or 2.70m adjacent-property underside clearance and 0.80m edge separation; reject occupation of light/vent patios and power-line corridors; for a highway or way below 12m require a source-qualified approved urban exception; consume other urban/structural limits from a same-model owner response
